name: Pando Rings
rootCause: Pando Rings was exploited via spot price oracle manipulation on Mixin in November 2022. The attacker manipulated the sBTC-WBTC price feed, transferred out $21.9 million in assets before services were halted and funds frozen, and attempted to steal up to $70 million. Mixin and project partners froze substantial remaining assets, and recovery efforts included forensic tracking and a promise to reimburse affected users. The attacker manipulated the spot price oracle for the sBTC-WBTC liquidity pool, causing the protocol to misprice collateral and enabling unauthorized withdrawals. The oracle relied on manipulable AMM reserves without adequate sanity checks.
